name: Serizawa Momoka
source: An air-headed otaku, Momoka is a first year high school student whose only real interest is in candy, anime and video games; she has near to zero interest in anything else. She was scouted by Coney with the promise of choobucks (candy); though it took a long time to motivate her into take her job seriously.
